name: Imogen Clare Satterly
theatre_group: the Riverbend Players (community troupe, joined about 2014)
roles: Mrs. Gibbs in Our Town (autumn 2019), Lady Bracknell in The Importance of Being Earnest (spring 2022), Abby Brewster in Arsenic and Old Lace (autumn 2022), directed a one-act at the regional festival (2023), Amanda Wingfield in The Glass Menagerie (2024), Madame Arcati in Blithe Spirit (2025)
charity: a neighborhood food pantry in West Asheville (volunteers Saturday mornings)
car: an old green hatchback the family calls the Pickle
holiday_habit: a week in a rented cottage on the Outer Banks every October
sibling: younger sister Celia Satterly, in Richmond
